description: Geological Survey & Mines Bureau - Regulations for amending the Mining (Licensing) Regulation No. 1 of 1993 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 794/23 of 26.11.1993
reasoning: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the President under the Mines and Minerals Act, No. 33 of 1992, specifically amending the Mining (Licensing) regulations. It involves legal amendments and regulatory modifications to existing mining legislation, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
